steps.label: 1886-definition-registration-cancel-stay
command: (() => new Promise((resolve,reject) => {const m=document.querySelector('#cancelConfirmModal.show');if(!m)return reject(Error('Expected ZIP cancel modal'));m.addEventListener('hidden.bs.modal',()=>resolve({action:'Cancel leaving the ZIP form'}),{once:true});m.querySelector('.modal-footer [data-bs-dismiss=modal]').click();}))()

steps.label: 1889-definition-registration-leave-confirm
command: (() => {const m=document.querySelector('#cancelConfirmModal.show');if(!m||location.pathname!=='/item/difi/form.donga')throw Error('Expected ZIP cancel modal');m.querySelector('[data-action-ok]').click();return {action:'Leave without saving the local QA file or metadata'};})()
